candidates.title: Optimizing cost and latency with Amazon Bedrock prompt caching
candidates.summary: Prompt caching in Amazon Bedrock can cut input token costs by up to 90% when you repeatedly send the same context to foundation models. This post walks through six practical prompt caching scenarios using the Converse API: message content, system prompt, tool definition, mixed TTL, tenant isolation, and LangChain integration.

candidates.title: Optimizing agent system prompts with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore
candidates.summary: AgentCore optimization turns production traces into proposed configuration changes, then validates them before promotion. This technical companion to the launch post explains how the system prompt optimizer's reflector engine works and shares benchmark results for the Single Agent and Sub-Agent Reflectors.
